summary: Wrote the 30-day KPI tree: Productivity game, MRR as the business north star, activated accounts (proposal_sent within 7 days of sign_up, closed 7-day cohorts) as the window steering metric, five inputs (visitors, visit-to-signup, activation, trial start, trial-to-paid), closed-window rules and assumption-labelled targets for two launch scenarios. No live data exists, so every target is an assumption except the owner's 50 trial_started goal.

alerts.title: Owner to confirm the north star and the window steering metric
alerts.detail: product.json says north_star 'revenue' and plan.md says MRR, which is a lagging revenue metric and fails the customer-centric test. reports/kpi-tree.md proposes MRR as the business KPI and activated accounts as the 30-day steering metric. Owner should confirm, along with plan questions 12-14 (free signup as conversion, trial card, targets).

alerts.title: KPI tree path mismatch with downstream tasks
alerts.detail: G02 brief says metrics/kpi-tree.md; this run wrote reports/kpi-tree.md as instructed. G08, G36, G37 and G39 read metrics/kpi-tree.md. Main session should pick one path and fix those task inputs. No duplicate was written.

alerts.title: 50 trial_started target looks out of reach on the assumptions
alerts.detail: At 3% visit-to-signup and 80% trial start, the 50-trial goal needs about 2,100 visitors in the window; the launch-scenario assumption gives about 36. G39 should test this with the owner's real go-live date.

alerts.title: No KPI can be observed yet
alerts.detail: Analytics, billing and the app event stream are not set up (accounts.analytics and accounts.payments are null). G36 should report 'no data' until T6/G07 and the app are live.
